hero.title: Seasonal plates, wood-fired warmth.
hero.text: A neighborhood kitchen serving seasonal, wood-fired dishes made from local produce.

about.title: Cooked over fire, shared at the table
about.text:
Saffron Table started as a supper club in a friend's backyard. Today we still cook the same way: over oak embers, with produce from farms within a hundred miles, and recipes meant to be passed around.

Whether it's a weeknight dinner or a celebration, we'd love to have you.
